rules.condition: When an AHB transfer is accepted and forwarded to AXI
rules.statement: The AXI address must equal the corresponding accepted AHB address (32-bit byte address).
HWDATA, WDATA, HRDATA and RDATA must each be 32 bits wide.
The bridge must not byte-swap data between AHB and AXI.
HSIZE/AxSIZE must encode 0 as 1 byte, 1 as 2 bytes and 2 as 4 bytes.

rules.condition: When HSIZE indicates a size larger than 4 bytes
rules.statement: The bridge must reject transfers with sizes larger than 4 bytes.
HWSTRB[n] and WSTRB[n] must qualify byte [8n+7:8n] of HWDATA/WDATA respectively.
The strobe must be passed from HWSTRB to WSTRB per beat.
The bridge must not perform any endian conversion.
AXI LEN must equal the beat count minus one.
LEN must be 0 for a single-beat transfer.

rules.condition: Aggregated write burst, before boundary split
rules.statement: AWLEN must be 3, 7 or 15 for an aggregated write burst before boundary split.
ID must be an unsigned 3-bit value.
Each direction (read and write) must rotate its ID independently through the configured count.
